fullContentHtml:
MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Online Form 2026 – Re-Open – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the notification for the Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post. This recruitment was released for 1700 posts. Re-Open Applications for the MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 will Start from 13 October 2026 & Candidate can apply till 27 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for MPESB Group 3 Sub Engineer & Other Post Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 August 2026
  • Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 12 September 2026
  • Form Re-Open
  • Application Start : 13 October 2026
  • Last Date : 27 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 28 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 560/-
  • OBC, SC, ST : Rs. 310/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 310/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges Extra : Rs. 60/- (Include)

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Re-Open Notice
